mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: expect 67 degrees with overcast skies near Reddan Soccer Park, and keep in mind we are in the Third Quarter moon phase.

The City of Verona has some great updates. You can sign up for free tri-shaw bike rides at the Senior Center for a nice tour of the Military Ridge State Trail, or check out seasonal job openings at the Rec Department.

We have a busy lineup. Today, check out the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, pizza and a pitcher at Wisconsin Brewing Company, or trivia at The Bogey Factory. Tomorrow, enjoy Concerts in the Park or trivia at Hop Haus Brewing.
In our weekly report, on July 31, an officer conducted a traffic stop that led to the arrest of a driver for O W I and several other traffic violations.
Today's flavor of the day is Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. The shop is currently closed but will open its doors at 10 AM. If you miss out, tomorrow's flavor will be Chocolate Caramel Twist.
